## Summary and scope

Describe behavior, roadmap PR, dependencies, architecture impact and non-goals.

## Verification

List exact commands and actual results, including blocked checks.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scoped to the intended roadmap PR
- [ ] User-visible behavior accurately described
- [ ] Test evidence provided
- [ ] Native/WASM portability checked where applicable
- [ ] Security and host-access boundaries reviewed
- [ ] Documentation distinguishes implemented and planned features
- [ ] Limitations, unresolved concerns and follow-ups listed
